jobs.title: Hotel Account Executive
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

As a Hotel Account Executive, you will play a key role in expanding our business within the hotel market. Your primary focus will be prospecting, building relationships, and securing new restaurant partnerships within major hotel brands, including Marriott, Hilton, and Choice Hotels, as well as supporting Independent/Boutique hotel properties and groups through the sales process. This role offers a highly cross-functional experience, where you’ll collaborate with multiple internal teams and work closely with independent, franchise and corporate contacts within the hotel industry.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Work within a list of prospective hotel properties within assigned geographical territory with restaurants, banquets, and retail outlets and manage the entire sales cycle, from the initial discovery calls to closing (experience with self-generating leads is preferred).
  • Conduct a high volume of calls, emails, and coordination efforts between internal teams, independent, franchisee or corporate hotel customers.
  • Deliver product demos and craft tailored solutions that best meet each prospect’s needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless delivery and meet the expectations set during the sales process.
  • Use Salesforce (CRM) to manage all sales activities and maintain up-to-date records.
  • Analyze the competitive landscape to strategically position Toast within the hotel market.
  • Clearly communicate the strengths, benefits, and potential challenges of Toast’s POS products and services, ensuring a smooth transition for customers.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the Master Service Agreements (MSA) of Enterprise Hotel customers to support account needs effectively.
  • Travel: 10%-15%

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 1+ years in an outbound sourcing or sales role (preferably in hospitality or a related field), with experience managing the full sales cycle from lead generation to closing.
  • Proven relationship-building skills with both internal and external stakeholders, managing high volumes of calls, emails, and coordination.
  • Familiarity with POS or tech solutions and ability to conduct tailored product demos.
  • Cross-functional collaboration experience to ensure seamless alignment between sales and delivery.
  • Effective communicator with strong verbal, written, and organizational skills; able to present product value clearly.
  • Technical proficiency with CRMs (Salesforce preferred) and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Market

jobs.title: Associate Account Manager
jobs.description:
The Associate Account Manager role is a new and developing function at Navan within the wider Account Management department. Associate Account Managers work alongside Account Managers to provide support to our Travel and Expense customers, specifically to program administrators. 

As an Associate Account Manager, you will be working with a team of account managers across different market segments and be responsible for delivering an outstanding customer experience. Your role will be to assist customers with product related configuration queries, troubleshooting and resolving issues. You will partner closely with our global Product, Finance, Operations and Travel Experience teams to ensure we are delighting our customers and helping them achieve their goals.

We are looking for individuals who have a passion for customer success and account management, embody a “go- getter” attitude, can communicate effectively and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You can expect world-class training and enablement and a fast track towards a revenue driving Account Manager role.

What You’ll Do:

  • Effectively partner with your assigned team of Account Managers to support their customers, ensuring excellent customer experience through timely, accurate communications.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of our travel and expense product offering to enable programme administrators on the Navan’s product functionality.
  • Monitor and respond to email inquiries from Travel and Expense Administrators related to product integrations and platform settings, travel and expense policy configuration, payment and integration issues troubleshooting and product bugs and feature requests, etc. .
  • Drive satisfaction, adoption, retention, and reduce customer churn risk by providing quick and knowledgeable advice based on customer’s desired outcomes.
  • Handle customer escalations and work across teams to resolve issues.
  • Act as the ‘voice of the customer’ and provide internal feedback on how we can better serve them to maximize customer value and retention.
  • Run playbooks and program ideas to drive adoption and satisfaction and track results based on defined KPIs.
  • Document processes to support the team efficiently and at scale.

What We’re Looking For: 

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar working experience.
  • 1+ year of prior experience in customer success, account management, sales or related customer-facing position within a rapidly growing SaaS company.
  • Passion for customer experience and technology with the ability to deeply understand a product.
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate complex concepts and technologies to diverse audiences including C-level executives.
